api/overview.title: API overview
api/overview.description: Document the public interface here. For each endpoint or function, list the purpose, parameters, response and errors.

architecture/adrs/ADR-0001-docusaurus-on.title: ADR-0001: Docusaurus on GitHub Pages for the docs
architecture/adrs/ADR-0001-docusaurus-on.description: The documentation site is built with Docusaurus and deployed to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

architecture/adrs/ADR-0002-justify-subdo.title: ADR-0002: Justify subdomains before creating them
architecture/adrs/ADR-0002-justify-subdo.description: A subdomain is created only if it needs a different runtime, security boundary, audience or external platform; otherwise content is delivered as a path.

architecture/adrs/ADR-0003-separate-publ.title: ADR-0003: Separate the public API from the webhook services
architecture/adrs/ADR-0003-separate-publ.description: The public portfolio API and the commercial webhook and workflow services are separate systems with separate repositories and hostnames.

architecture/adrs/index.title: Architecture decision records
architecture/adrs/index.description: The log of significant architecture decisions for rjmlaird.co.uk, with status, and the backlog of decisions still to be written down.

architecture/apis-integrations.title: APIs and integrations
architecture/apis-integrations.description: The services behind rjmlaird.co.uk, how they are separated, the conventions they follow and the third-party systems they connect to.

architecture/automation-workflows.title: Automation and workflows
architecture/automation-workflows.description: The scheduled jobs, queue consumers and CI workflows that run without manual intervention, and the principles for building new ones safely.

architecture/content-platform.title: Content platform architecture
architecture/content-platform.description: How content for rjmlaird.co.uk and docs.rjmlaird.co.uk is authored, validated and rendered, including the shared brand system and its known synchronisation gap.

architecture/domain-model.title: Domain and DNS model
architecture/domain-model.description: How rjmlaird.co.uk and its subdomains are resolved, which parts of the DNS setup are confirmed, and the rules for adding or retiring a subdomain.

architecture/environments.title: Environments and deployment model
architecture/environments.description: How code moves from a local machine to production for the docs site and the Cloudflare Workers services, with the verified CI/CD pipeline, branching rules and known gaps.

architecture/media-assets-cdn.title: Media, assets and CDN strategy
architecture/media-assets-cdn.description: How images, files and other static assets are stored, served and cached across rjmlaird.co.uk, with a proposal to use one asset host instead of several.

architecture/observability-status.title: Observability, status and incident response
architecture/observability-status.description: How the health of the ecosystem is monitored, how status is communicated and what to do when something breaks. Mostly proposed; little is confirmed.

architecture/overview.title: Architecture overview
architecture/overview.description: A map of the rjmlaird.co.uk ecosystem, showing what is live, what is being built and what is only planned, plus the principles that govern how the pieces fit together.

architecture/roadmap.title: Roadmap and decision log
architecture/roadmap.description: The sequence in which planned parts of the rjmlaird.co.uk ecosystem should be built or documented, the decisions still open and where decisions are recorded.

architecture/security-privacy-access.title: Security, privacy and access control
architecture/security-privacy-access.description: Who can reach what across rjmlaird.co.uk, how secrets and sessions are handled, and the privacy considerations that follow from the integrations in use.

architecture/standards.title: Naming conventions and standards
architecture/standards.description: Naming rules for hostnames, repositories, Workers and routes, plus the page template, front matter, status labels and callout conventions for architecture documentation.

architecture/subdomain-catalogue.title: Subdomain catalogue
architecture/subdomain-catalogue.description: The register of every planned, live and deferred subdomain of rjmlaird.co.uk, with status, purpose, hosting pattern, priority and a recommendation to keep, merge, defer or avoid each one.

getting-started/quickstart.title: Quickstart
getting-started/quickstart.description: This page takes you from a fresh install to a working result in a few minutes.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: Welcome to the documentation for my projects and tools. These docs are written for developers, integrators and collaborators who need to learn a tool and rely on it.

tutorials/first-tutorial.title: Your first tutorial
tutorials/first-tutorial.description: A tutorial teaches by doing. State the goal, list what the reader needs, then give numbered steps that each produce a visible result.
